neighbours.label: A J-initial piece after a hyphen, bracket or at a word start: '-J' in al-Jalalayn and May-June, '(j' in NOTE(jamie), ' J' in JET
fire: The Tafsir al-Jalalayn is widely read.
Our program runs April-May-June this year.
Work at the JET LABORATORY began in May.
The Sunan al-Jami is on the shelf.
Staff at the JET PROPULSION LAB left early.
quiet: The Tafsir al-Tabari is widely read.
Our program runs April and May this year.
Work at the RED LABORATORY began in May.
The volumes cover 1890 to 1899 in all.
The Sunan al-Kubra is on the shelf.
Staff at the NAVAL RESEARCH LAB left early.

predictions: J-pieces fire; the same frames with other letters stay quiet.
